$comment: App -> workflow layer. Runs go to the per-app host in workflows/deployments.json (override with COMFY_BASE_URL_<SLUG>), not https://cloud.comfy.org. cloudWorkflowId values are only for opening a copy in the Comfy editor. Auth is COMFY_API_KEY, or COMFY_CLOUD_API_KEY if that is the name already set.

product-relight.title: Product Relight

presets.studio: clean professional studio lighting, a soft white key light from the {direction} with gentle fill light, soft realistic shadows, neutral light grey background
presets.golden: warm golden hour sunlight coming from the {direction}, long soft shadows, warm orange and amber tones, soft haze
presets.neon: vivid neon lighting: saturated magenta and electric cyan neon light coming from the {direction}, strong colored rim light on the product edges, dark moody background with soft neon glow, colorful reflections

product-relight.promptTemplate: 重新照明, relight the image using {intensity} {preset}, keep the product shape, materials and details unchanged

sprite-generator.title: Sprite Generator

styles.toon: flat 2D toon style with bold outlines
styles.pixel: crisp pixel-art style, 32x32-pixel look, limited palette

sprite-generator.promptTemplate: Create a character sprite sheet of {subject}: a {frames}-frame {motion}. Arrange the {frames} frames in a {grid} grid of equal cells, reading left to right, top to bottom. Keep the exact same character design, colors, proportions and outfit in every frame; only the pose changes to form a smooth loop. {style}, full body visible in each cell, character centered, consistent scale, plain flat white background, no text, no labels, no grid lines.

prompt.template: Replace the outfit with the reference garment, {fit} fit

background-removal.title: Background Removal
background-removal.notes: Output is an RGBA PNG. White / lilac backgrounds are composited client-side on a canvas.
